wikidot5e:spell:call-lightning.effectSummary: Create a storm cloud directly above you, a 10-foot-tall cylinder with a 60-foot radius centered on a visible point in range; if you cannot see a location in the air that can contain it, the spell fails. On casting, choose a visible point beneath the cloud: each creature within 5 feet makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d10 lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. On each later turn you can use your action to call another bolt at the same or a different point beneath the cloud. If cast outdoors during stormy weather, you control the existing storm instead and each bolt deals an extra 1d10. Each slot level above 3rd adds another 1d10 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:calm-emotions.effectSummary: Each humanoid in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered within range makes a Charisma save, which it may choose to fail. For each failed target, choose either to suppress any effect currently making it charmed or frightened, with that effect resuming when this spell ends if its own duration remains, or to make it indifferent toward creatures you choose that it is hostile toward. Indifference ends early if the target is attacked, harmed by a spell, or sees one of its friends harmed; when the spell ends the creature becomes hostile again unless the DM rules otherwise.

wikidot5e:spell:catapult.effectSummary: Choose an unattended object in range weighing 1–5 pounds. It flies in a straight line up to 90 feet in a direction you choose, stopping early on a solid surface. If it would hit a creature, that creature makes a Dexterity save; on a failure the object strikes it and stops. Whenever the object strikes something, both the object and the struck target take 3d8 bludgeoning damage. Each slot level above 1st increases the maximum target weight by 5 pounds and the damage by 1d8.

wikidot5e:spell:catnap.effectSummary: Up to three willing creatures you can see within range become unconscious for 10 minutes. A target wakes early if it takes damage or another creature uses an action to shake or slap it awake. A target that remains unconscious for the full duration gains the benefits of a short rest and cannot benefit from this spell again until it finishes a long rest.

wikidot5e:spell:cause-fear.effectSummary: Choose one visible creature in range; constructs and undead are immune. The target makes a Wisdom save or becomes frightened of you until the spell ends, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns and ending the effect on itself on a success. Each slot level above 1st adds one target, and all chosen creatures must be within 30 feet of one another.

wikidot5e:spell:ceremony.effectSummary: Choose one ceremony whose target stays within 10 feet of you throughout the 1-hour casting. Atonement: touch a willing creature whose alignment changed and make a DC 20 Wisdom (Insight) check; on success restore its original alignment. Bless Water: turn one touched vial of water into holy water. Coming of Age: a young-adult humanoid you touch can add 1d4 to ability checks for 24 hours; a creature can benefit only once. Dedication: a humanoid willingly dedicated to your god can add 1d4 to saving throws for 24 hours; a creature can benefit only once. Funeral Rite: for 7 days, a touched corpse cannot become undead except by wish. Wedding: willing adult humanoids you touch gain +2 AC while within 30 feet of one another for 7 days; a creature can receive this rite again only if widowed.

wikidot5e:spell:chain-lightning.effectSummary: Choose a visible creature or object in range as the first target, then up to three additional creatures or objects each within 30 feet of that first target. A target can be hit by only one bolt. Each target makes a Dexterity save, taking 10d8 lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. Each slot level above 6th adds one additional secondary bolt and target within 30 feet of the first target.

wikidot5e:spell:chaos-bolt.effectSummary: Make a ranged spell attack against one creature in range. On a hit it takes 2d8+1d6 damage. Choose either d8 result to set the damage type: 1 acid, 2 cold, 3 fire, 4 force, 5 lightning, 6 poison, 7 psychic, or 8 thunder. If both d8s show the same number, the bolt leaps to a different creature you choose within 30 feet of the target; make a new attack and damage roll, which can leap again on another matching pair. A creature can be targeted only once by the same casting. Each slot level above 1st adds 1d6 damage to every target, using that attack's rolled damage type.

wikidot5e:spell:charm-monster.effectSummary: One visible creature in range makes a Wisdom save, with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it. On a failure it is charmed by you and friendly to you until the spell ends or you or your companions harm it. When the charm ends, it knows you charmed it. Each slot level above 4th adds one target, and all targets must be within 30 feet of one another.

wikidot5e:spell:charm-person.effectSummary: One visible humanoid in range makes a Wisdom save, with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it. On a failure it is charmed by you, regarding you as a friendly acquaintance, until the spell ends or you or your companions harm it. When the charm ends, it knows you charmed it. Each slot level above 1st adds one humanoid target, and all targets must be within 30 feet of one another.
